lesson_ratings.title: Les Retrouvailles Inattendues
lesson_ratings.reason: Provides natural conversational French and common informal expressions.

lesson_ratings.title: Prendre un Numéro
lesson_ratings.reason: Excellent informal vocabulary like 'se refasse une bouffe' and 'un de ces quatre'.

lesson_ratings.title: Le Moment de Vérité (Part 2)
lesson_ratings.reason: High-quality vocabulary and grammar, featuring adverbs and expressions like 'faire semblant'.

lesson_ratings.title: Les Regrets et les Excuses
lesson_ratings.reason: Rich in colloquial expressions and useful verbs like 'se croiser' and 'disparaître'.

lesson_ratings.title: Si Seulement...
lesson_ratings.reason: Great practice for conditional tense verbs and expressions like 'avoir l'air de'.

lesson_ratings.title: Les Souvenirs Flous
lesson_ratings.reason: Good conversational practice using past tenses and adverbs like 'sincèrement'.

lesson_ratings.title: L'Arrivée de Flo
lesson_ratings.reason: Short and consists mostly of basic greetings and repetitive filler.

lesson_ratings.title: Les Présentations Difficiles
lesson_ratings.reason: Mostly repeats the structure and key lines of Lesson 4 with minor pronoun changes.

lesson_ratings.title: La Vérité en Chanson
lesson_ratings.reason: Full of rich idiomatic expressions like 'en faire toute une histoire' and 'lancer un regard'.

lesson_ratings.title: Deviner le Prénom
lesson_ratings.reason: Contains a few useful colloquialisms like 'chiant' and 'du coup', but is mostly names and filler.
